title: Notebook
pitch: A Jupyter-style lab notebook: markdown cells argue, code cells show each number and its derivation, one params cell re-runs everything.
bestFor: Quantitative research the reader should audit and re-run: cost models, sizing, benchmarks, forecasts.
weakness: Reads as an engineer's artefact; prose-heavy findings, recommendations and risks get little special treatment.
signals: a model with inputs the reader would change
numbers derived step by step from sourced rates
reader wants to check the derivation
avoid: narrative or argument for a non-technical reader
many parts whose relationships matter more than numbers
